headline: Row Reawakens as Shelf and Expanse Turn
war_summary: Since the 03:10 edition the wires have quickened on the Row while the Shelf and Expanse keep turning, with Fisherman's Row logging four changes in two hours to 06:10 for twenty-five on the day about Arcadia, Black Well and Eidolo, standing seven Colonial with two neutral, while Stlican Shelf added two changes to the cutoff for thirty on the day about Fort Hoarfrost, The Old Mourn and The Pale House at seven Warden to two Colonial, and the Weathered Expanse added three changes to 04:55 for thirty-three on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk at four Warden to five Colonial. Godcrofts, Stonecradle and Linn Mercy have gone quiet in the last two hours after fifty-six, sixteen and eight changes on the day respectively, as have Tempest Island, Marban Hollow, Deadlands, Farranac Coast and Mooring County, the latter still showing more than nine thousand casualties in the day, while Callahan's Passage remains without a change despite more than eighteen thousand casualties in the day and ten Warden holdings.
